subject: Activation sprint agenda, owners & firm dates for Suncrest Analytics
messages:
From: Grace Lin <grace.lin@suncrest.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@suncrest.ai>, procurement@suncrest.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff & high-level timeline request for Redwood rollout

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Suncrest is excited about the latency gains and the caching profile you showed. Our leadership asked for a concrete activation plan we can share with IT and procurement: a short sprint-by-sprint agenda, milestones, who owns each task on both sides, and firm target dates so we can book reviewers.

Could you send a proposed sprint agenda and owners by end of day Monday? Procurement will need the billing/term cadence and any vendor docs to start their review.

Thanks,
Grace

--
Grace Lin
VP, Data Platforms | Suncrest Analytics
grace.lin@suncrest.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Lin <grace.lin@suncrest.ai>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@suncrest.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff & high-level timeline request for Redwood rollout

Grace —

Appreciate the quick follow. Attached is a working activation sprint agenda (Redwood_Activation_Sprint_Agenda_v1.xlsx) and a short annotated requirements doc (Suncrest_Requirements_annotated.pdf). High level summary below, owners noted per line item:

Sprint 0 (Week of May 24) — Prep & network- Owner (Suncrest): Grace / Evan — VPC peering, firewall rules, IP allowlist- Owner (Redwood): Aditya — Test endpoints, baseline perf profile

Sprint 1 (Week of May 31) — Core integration & auth- Owner (Suncrest): IT eng lead (TBD) — integrate API keys, JWT exchange- Owner (Redwood): Monica Patel — auth flows, token rotation test

Sprint 2 (Week of Jun 7) — Data & prompt validation- Owner (Suncrest): Data infra — sample dataset push, embeddings validation- Owner (Redwood): Lauren Bishop — prompt tuning checklist, evals

Sprint 3 (Week of Jun 14) — Scale testing & go/no-go- Owner (Suncrest): SRE — load test validation- Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — autoscale policy and failover tests

Projected go-live window: Jun 18-21 (final go/no-go decision on Jun 16).

Next steps I recommend: 1) Confirm owners for Suncrest roles above, 2) Procurement review of attached term summary, 3) Kickoff call May 24 to align sprint 0 tasks.

I attached the spreadsheet with task-level owners and a column for acceptance criteria. If this looks good, I'll convert the sheet to a shared Drive timeline and generate a HubSpot MAP record.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Lead, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0110

Attachments: Redwood_Activation_Sprint_Agenda_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Suncrest_Requirements_annotated.pdf (pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Grace Lin <grace.lin@suncrest.ai>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@suncrest.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff & high-level timeline request for Redwood rollout

Looping in a couple of notes from engineering re: owners and risks.

Aditya — I updated the sheet with two suggested changes:
- Move token rotation test to Sprint 0 (we should validate long-lived token behavior before auth integration).
- Add a short pre-sprint security checklist (SOC2 artifact pointer + KMS key naming) — Grace / Evan, if your security team has a contact we should include them in the kickoff.

Risk: If Suncrest cannot confirm IP allowlist early, the Sprint 0 timeline could slip 1 week. We should have a contingency on the timeline (alternate week of Jun 21 for go-live).

Happy to run the May 24 kickoff and walk through the spreadsheet line-by-line.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Grace Lin <grace.lin@suncrest.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@suncrest.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@suncrest.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff & high-level timeline request for Redwood rollout

Aditya / Monica — this looks good and the dates are tight but workable. Quick answers:
- Security contact: Julia Park (julia.park@suncrest.ai) — she can join the May 24 kickoff.
- Procurement: procurement@suncrest.ai will start with the term summary; they asked if you can provide a standard SOW template and a vendor W-9 / tax form.

We confirm Sprint 0 kickoff on Monday May 24 at 10:00am PT. Evan and Julia will join. Can Redwood share the Drive version of the agenda and a one-page SOW stub before the meeting?

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Grace
